_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit the values below. Webhook URLs go in GitHub secrets, NOT here.
_gex_ticker_comment: GEX is computed from options chains. NQ/MNQ futures don't have a retail options chain, so QQQ (or ^NDX) is used as the correlated proxy.
_gex_expirations_comment: 1 = nearest expiration only (0DTE-style, noisier day to day). 2-3 = smoother, steadier read. There's no single 'correct' value - this is a design choice.

forex_factory._impact_comment: High = red folder, Medium = orange, Low = yellow, Holiday = gray. Add/remove to taste.
